title: La Laguna de Apoyo
goal: Swim in a crater and be warned about the current
culture: The water is warm because there is a volcano underneath it, which is not a metaphor. The afternoon wind on that crater is the reason there are rules, and salga ya is not a suggestion even though it is delivered like one.

beats.good: Honda, not profunda — the everyday word. The answer is about two hundred metres and nobody has ever touched the bottom of it.
No vaya from him, no voy from you. It is a real warning delivered gently: the far side is a very long way back.

beats.es: Y el agua es tibia, fíjese. Meta la mano.
beats.good: It is warm because there is a volcano underneath it. That is not a figure of speech.
Salga ya from him, ya salgo from you, and do not argue about it. The afternoon wind on that crater is the reason there are rules at all.
